title: Costs of Modifying Existing Software
summary: Addressed whether costs of modifying existing computer software should be expensed or capitalised, treating modifications the same way as new software development. Withdrawn in 2004.

related.title: Intangible Assets
related.relationship: The parent standard whose 2004 revision superseded SIC-6 by incorporating software modification guidance directly into IAS 38

related.title: Property, Plant and Equipment
related.relationship: Applies where software forms an integral part of related hardware, outside SIC-6's primary scope
